evals.name: Scrape a webpage into markdown
prompts: Get me the full content of https://docs.firecrawl.dev/introduction as clean markdown so I can read it.
judges: The agent returns the page's content as readable markdown text including headings and paragraphs from the Firecrawl introduction page.

evals.name: Search the web for recent news
prompts: What are the latest developments in LLM context window sizes? Give me current results from the web.
judges: The agent returns a set of recent, relevant web results about LLM context window sizes with titles, snippets, and URLs.

evals.name: Map all URLs on a website
prompts: Give me a full list of URLs on https://firecrawl.dev without fetching each page's content.
judges: The agent returns a list of discovered URLs from the firecrawl.dev domain using the map tool.

evals.name: Crawl a documentation site
prompts: Crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev and return the markdown content from up to 20 pages under the /features path.
judges: The agent initiates a crawl scoped to the /features path, retrieves content from multiple pages, and returns markdown results.

evals.name: Interact with a dynamic page
prompts: Go to https://news.ycombinator.com and click on the first story link, then return the content of the page it opens.
judges: The agent uses a browser interaction to navigate to Hacker News, clicks a story link, and returns readable content from the destination page.

evals.name: Run a structured research agent job
prompts: Find the founding year, CEO name, and headquarters city for Stripe, Plaid, and Brex. Return the results as structured JSON.
judges: The agent returns a JSON object or array with founding year, CEO name, and headquarters city for each of the three companies.

evals.name: Search for scientific papers on a topic
prompts: Find recent research papers about transformer attention mechanisms and their computational efficiency. Show me titles, authors, and abstracts.
judges: The agent returns a list of relevant scientific papers with titles, authors, and abstract summaries on transformer attention efficiency.

evals.name: Create a page change monitor
prompts: Set up a monitor that checks https://openai.com/news every day and alerts me when new articles are published.
judges: The agent creates a recurring monitor targeting the OpenAI news page on a daily schedule and returns a monitor ID or confirmation.

evals.name: Look up a company's contact details
prompts: Find the LinkedIn URL, website, and employee count for the company Notion (notion.so).
judges: The agent returns enriched firmographic data for Notion including at least one of LinkedIn URL, website, or employee count.

evals.name: Check Firecrawl credit balance
prompts: How many Firecrawl credits do I have left in my account right now?
judges: The agent calls the credit usage tool and reports the remaining credit balance for the authenticated account.
